reviews.reason: s0009 Chinese is 由是奇之 with no 武帝 in the unit; both before and after supply an anaphoric English subject. Wu Di is an accepted alternate-name for jinshu:053:p004 (武帝), and Emperor Wu is the title form used in s0003. This is chapter-internal consistency among accurate proper-name forms, not an omission or mistranslation. No rule that Wu Di must become Emperor Wu.

Same sentence and same person as proposal 0; literal 'Wu Di' is also an accepted alias, not a false reading of 由是奇之. Aligning literal with neighboring 'Emperor Wu' is optional style. Not a required repair.

s0201 惠帝即位 is correctly named either Hui Di or Emperor Hui; Hui Di is an accepted alternate-name with evidence on this unit, and the unit literal already uses Emperor Hui. Paired-field inconsistency is real but both forms are accurate. No rule that Hui Di must always be Emperor Hui.
